mapper.insert: insert into salary_rule (name, semester_id, category, difficulty_level, base_wage, coefficient, max_monthly, min_monthly, priority, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{name}, #{semesterId}, #{category}, #{difficultyLevel}, #{baseWage}, #{coefficient}, #{maxMonthly}, #{minMonthly}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: update salary_rule set name = #{name}, semester_id = #{semesterId}, category = #{category}, difficulty_level = #{difficultyLevel}, base_wage = #{baseWage}, coefficient = #{coefficient}, max_monthly = #{maxMonthly}, min_monthly = #{minMonthly}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select id, name, semester_id, category, difficulty_level, base_wage, coefficient, max_monthly, min_monthly, priority, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user from salary_rule
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and (semester_id = #{semesterId} or semester_id is null)
and (category = #{category} or category is null)
order by priority asc, id asc

select id, name, semester_id, category, difficulty_level, base_wage, coefficient, max_monthly, min_monthly, priority, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user from salary_rule where status = 1
and (semester_id = #{semesterId} or semester_id is null)
order by priority asc, id asc
